name: godot-color-visualizer
description: Visualize and edit Godot colors (C#, GDScript, GDShader, TSCN, TRES, BBCode) while preserving their original format.

godotColorVisualizer.displayStyle.description: Visual style used to display colors in the editor.

godotColorVisualizer.enableCodeFiles.description: Enable color visualization in code files (.cs, .gd, .gdshader).

godotColorVisualizer.enableResourceFiles.description: Enable color visualization in Godot resource and project files (.tscn, .tres, project.godot).

godotColorVisualizer.floatPrecision.description: Maximum number of decimal places for float values (e.g., 0.25f).

godotColorVisualizer.customPatterns.description: Additional regular expressions with named capture groups (?<r>, ?<g>, ?<b>, ?<a> or ?<hex>).

name.description: Display name for this custom pattern.

extensions.description: Target file extensions (e.g., ['.cs', '.gd']). Leave empty for all supported files.

regex.description: Regular expression with named capture groups: r, g, b, a or hex.

format.description: Color value representation used by this pattern.

useFloatSuffix.description: Append the 'f' suffix to float numbers (e.g., for C#).
